mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which positively impacts consumer confidence and spending, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is low but SPX returns are negative more than 35% of the time, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but SPX returns are positive more than 35% of the time, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) jointly indicate strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both INDPRO and HOUST increase but SPX returns are negative more than 35% of the time, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle, a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) stimulates economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases in an easing cycle but SPX returns are negative more than 35% of the time, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but SPX returns are negative more than 35% of the time, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases but SPX returns are negative more than 35% of the time, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 grows and UNRATE is low but SPX returns are negative more than 35% of the time, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL is high but SPX returns are positive more than 35% of the time, the hypothesis is falsified.
